items.title: Compositions of Koszul-regular, H1-regular, and mixed quasi-regular immersions of spaces stay in class
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For immersions i : Z -> Y and j : Y -> X of algebraic spaces over S, the lemma proves three closure statements: Koszul-regular composed with Koszul-regular is Koszul-regular; likewise H1-regular with H1-regular; and an H1-regular i followed by a quasi-regular j gives a quasi-regular composite. The retained proof is written: immediate from the case of schemes via Divisors, lemma composition-regular-immersion, quoted by name — the regularity notions are etale-local on the source so scheme-chart proofs glue verbatim; nothing space-specific is added. Retained author proof at lines 10667-10670.
